content: Geb ibbogwadgine, vino-gobsimaladgine, Rey-Asuero, Esterʼse gannar ibmar egichialid: —Ester, be anga soge, ibu be abege, ar an bega ukoed. Amba an-yar-naid-negabar be anse egisele, an bega uksaled.

Geb degine, e-ome-Ester rey-abin sogded: —Rey, be yeer-an-dakele, be nued-itogele, an bese ibmar egisoed be anga imakodo. Unnila an bese egised, mer be an-oburgwena gadin, dula-gudii be an-imakena gadin. Deginbali, an bese egisbalid, mer be an-dulemar-oburgwemogana gadinye.
Ar ade, ani, bela an-dulemarmala-oburgwilegega manigi ukles bukwad. Ar weyob guele, reyga boniga gudoed. Ar anmar unnila maiga-guega-uklesana, adi, an sunmakosulinad. An bese wilenaisulinad.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero, Esterʼse egichided: —Degite, ¿Doa-dule we-ibmar-isgana imakbi gudisunna? ¿Bia we-dule gudii?
Geb Ester, reyga sogded: —¡Anmar-isdarad anmargi gwisgudiidi, we-dule-isgana, Amán gued! Amán weyob-itosgua, rey-asabin, degi, rey-ome-Ester-asabin dobedba ganna gwisgusad.

Geb Rey-Asuero urwedgi gwichibin-imaksad, bar gobsasulid, geb reyneggi-dutumar-galuse noded. Ar Amánʼdi, rey e-oburgoed daksabinsoggu, rey-ome-Ester-walik bessunnad, adi, e-san-bendakega Esterʼgi nue-wilenai guegar.

Rey-Asuero reyneggi-dutumar-galuse-gudiidgi gannar neg-mas-gullenaidse-dognonigua, daknonikid, Amánʼdi, Ester-maidgi dulluu gunai. Rey weyob-daksagua, binnasur goted: —An-wagab, an-neggi, ¿be an-ome gagabibarde? ¡Adi, sulirgebed! Suar-ibmala Rey weyob-gole-itosmargua, dognonimalad. Geb Amán-e-wagar edusmalad.

Suar-ibed-wargwen Harbonaʼye-nugad, Rey-Asueroʼga sogded: —Amán e-neg-nagaba Judío-dule-rey-san-bendaksagusad-Mardoqueo-dukar-gaega, suar ogwichisad. We-suarde daliambe-gakabo gaka negabar-nibgue (12½) gwichid. Geb Rey-Asuero igar ukded: —¡Be a-suargi dukar-gaale Amán-nasikmar!
Deyobi, Amán, Mardoqueo-e-dukar-gaega suar-ogwichisadgi, dukargi-edinnar nasiklesad. Geb rey baisur-itoded.
